items.title: Warren Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, March 17, 2018
items.q: Charlie Parker came to my house to get his horn fixed... And we’re sitting there looking at Bird.

ctx.x: I mean everybody, Charlie Parker came to Chicago and his horn needed fixing, so the first person he came to was my father. And we’re sitting there looking at Bird. And all he wanted was to have his horn fixed. But I mean all the saxophone players came there to get their instruments repaired.
You knew who Bird was then?
